releaseNotes:
1.0.0-preview.8
- Added: FrameException — the base type for all Frame failures. Consumers can now catch every Frame error in a single block, including integration-specific failures, instead of relying on built-in .NET exceptions.
- Added: BlazorFrameException (in Circuids.Frame.Blazor) — base type for Blazor integration failures; derives from FrameException so a Core-level catch (FrameException) also handles Blazor failures.
- Breaking (for Blazor consumers catching operational failures): Blazor state failures (camera not opened before use) now throw BlazorFrameException instead of InvalidOperationException. Argument-validation null guards still throw ArgumentNullException and are unchanged.

1.0.0-preview.7
- No API changes; shipped with the Blazor integration fix for JS stream-reference byte transfers (see Circuids.Frame.Blazor release notes)

1.0.0-preview.6
- No API changes; shipped with the Blazor integration fixes for capture image encoding and the overlay viewfinder removal (see Circuids.Frame.Blazor release notes)

1.0.0-preview.5
- No API changes; shipped with the Blazor integration fix for OpenCV.js video-element input (see Circuids.Frame.Blazor release notes)

1.0.0-preview.4
- BREAKING: IDocumentDetector.Detect removed; replaced by ValueTask<DetectionResult> DetectAsync(CameraFrame, DetectionOptions, CancellationToken)
- BREAKING: CameraFrame.Data is now byte[]? (null when the platform keeps pixel data on-device, e.g. a live video element)
- BREAKING: ICameraProvider gains GetFrameDimensionsAsync (intrinsic live-frame dimensions, no byte transfer)
- Added: CameraPermission.NotSupported and CameraPermission.NotAvailable; RequestPermissionAsync never throws for expected camera failures (missing hardware, busy device, unsupported API, denial)

1.0.0-preview.3
- Fixed JS Interop Issues and etc..

1.0.0-preview.2
- Breaking: flattened all namespaces to Circuids.Frame (removed Configuration, Contracts, Results, Events, Export, Extensions sub-namespaces)
- All public types now in Circuids.Frame root namespace

1.0.0-preview.1
- Initial preview release
- Platform-neutral Core: configuration, results, events, contracts, and DI extension
- Camera access and lifecycle contract (ICameraProvider) with permission request support
- Document detection contract (IDocumentDetector) with high-level sensitivity and performance knobs
- Capture pipeline contract (ICapturePipeline) for perspective-corrected capture
- Image enhancement contract (IImageProcessor)
- PDF export contract (IPdfExporter) with programmatic byte generation and print dialog modes
- FrameOptions with sensible defaults for zero-configuration scanning
- Immutable result records: FrameScanResult, DetectionResult, CornerPoints, ImageDimensions
- CameraPermission enum: NotDetermined, Granted, Denied
- AddFrame DI extension (idempotent, order-independent)
title: Frame - Core
